A small repair workshop in Larkbend. Tune-ups, wheel builds and cargo bike care, done while you wait or by the next morning.

What we do

Tune-ups

Gears indexed, brakes set, chain cleaned and every bolt checked to torque.

See tune-up levels

Wheels

Truing, spoke replacement and hand-built wheels for road, gravel and town bikes.

See wheel work

Cargo bikes

Longtails and front-loaders, with the space and the stands to work on them properly.
